ns2:course.label: Production
ns2:course.description: (ARTGD 220) Basic information and current methods in the production of multiple printed communications, including printing processes, papermaking, binding and other practices, and the preparation of art work for the various methods of reproduction; field trips required. Prerequisite: ARTD 210 and ARTD 212 or consent of instructor; concurrent registration in ARTD 310 or ARTD 311 by students in Graphic Design.
